lines.text: Jesus teaches beside the sea from a boat, and a farmer goes out to sow his seed.
Seed falls on the path, rocky ground, thorns and good soil, and the good soil produces a crop.
Alone with the Twelve, Jesus says the mystery of the kingdom of heaven has been given to them.

wrong_details.wrong: the mystery of the kingdom of heaven
wrong_details.true: the mystery of the kingdom of God

lines.text: Jesus explains that the farmer sows the word, and on the path the birds take it away.

wrong_details.true: Satan comes and takes away the word

lines.text: Jesus compares the kingdom of God to a mustard seed, which grows into the largest of all garden plants.
